response.sql: WITH media_averages AS (SELECT MediaTypeId, AVG(UnitPrice) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(Bytes * 1.0 / NULLIF(Milliseconds, 0)) AS byte_rate FROM Track GROUP BY MediaTypeId), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate FROM media_averages) SELECT AVG(m.avg_unit_price) AS avg_unit_price, AVG(m.byte_rate) AS avg_byte_rate, AVG(m.byte_rate - b.avg_byte_rate) AS avg_rate_excess FROM media_averages AS m CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE m.byte_rate > b.avg_byte_rate
